units.source_text: “我没有点空，是五目，不过……据估算，大概是六十八对七十三吧。

en.t: "I have not counted the territory; it is five points, but... by estimate, it is probably sixty-eight to seventy-three.
In fact, once it is counted carefully, it will be even less.

units.source_text: ”结果是黑五十六目，白五十一目。

en.t: "The result was fifty-six points for Black and fifty-one points for White.
